sloka: वसेत् सह सपत्नेन क्रुद्धेन आशी विषेण च ।न तु मित्र प्रवादेन सम्वस्च्चत्रुणा सह ॥६-१६-२॥।।
transliteration: vaset saha sapatnena kruddhena āśī viṣeṇa ca ।na tu mitra pravādena samvasccatruṇā saha ॥6-16-2॥।।

translations.english: "One can live with a known enemy or even with an angry and venomous serpent but cannot stay together with one who professes to be a friend and devoted to an enemy."
